title: Dry Swab Sampling and Transportation
author: Chunan Liu

steps_raw.instruction: Break the seal round the tube containing the swab

steps_raw.title: Swabbing
steps_raw.instruction: Designate a location to be swabbed, taking care to note the size of the area. Remove the swab from the tube, swab the entire area in a zigzag pattern, rolling the swab over to ensure the entire swab is used.

steps_raw.title: Return the swab into the tube and label the sample
steps_raw.instruction: Carefully insert the swab into the tube, making sure to seat the cap firmly on the tube. Label the sample with a unique identifier, such as the patient_ID, location the sample was taken, the date.
Place the tube into the biohazard bag and seal the bag, store at room temp (or 4ºC, if available)

steps_raw.title: Shipping instructions
steps_raw.instruction: Place samples and all paperwork in Styrofoam container and arrange shipment for next day delivery. Do not ship over the weekend.
